relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin-induced activation of nociceptive C-fibers in the skin is mainly mediated by calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) and induces cutaneous vessel dilatation and flare response.

key_findings: Capsaicin-induced dermal blood flow increased more in trigeminal dermatomes than forearm; V1 response smaller in migraine patients than controls.
